title: HGM-Dual: Lineage-Aware Guided Agent Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Planning
title_zh: HGM-Dual：面向长程规划的谱系感知引导智能体框架优化

paragraphs.en: Harness optimization, which improves an agent’s prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin–Gödel Machine and the Huxley–Gödel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit–outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent’s highest-ranked constraint violations. HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45 % 14.45\% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants’ final performance with 2 × 2\times – 4 × 4\times fewer evaluation budget.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架优化，即改进智能体的提示词、工具和工作流，是提升基于冻结或闭源大语言模型构建的智能体的一种日益有效的方法。 以达尔文–哥德尔机器和赫胥黎–哥德尔机器（HGM）为代表的领先方法依赖递归自我改进，且主要为编程任务而开发；在编程任务中，改进智能体所需的能力与被改进的能力是重合的。 规划任务要求智能体生成一序列工具调用，使之共同满足相互作用的约束，这类任务打破了上述一致性。 在规划任务中，开放式自我修改会反复探索无效改动，并消耗大量评估预算。 我们提出 HGM-Dual，一个面向规划智能体的、由诊断引导的预算高效框架优化框架。 首先，HGM-Dual 将智能体演化表示为具有谱系感知的上下文。 该上下文记录每个祖先做了哪些改动、哪些行为得到改善或退化、哪些修改是无效的，从而为编辑器提供显式的「编辑–结果」归因，而非过去智能体的非结构化存档。 其次，HGM-Dual 引入由错误条件化的双路径子代生成机制。 对于每个被选中的父代，它会生成一个保留开放式探索的通用子代，以及若干专门子代，这些专门子代针对最可能导致父代最高优先级约束违反的框架组件。 HGM-Dual 超越最强基线，在案例准确率上最高取得 14.45% 的相对提升，同时以 2×–4× 更少的评估预算达到与 HGM 变体相当的最终性能。

paragraphs.en: First, effective improvement requires a structured context of the search history . Planning benchmarks expose a relatively small and recurring set of constraint failures, so different agents in the search tree often encounter similar problems. If an editor observes only its current parent’s evaluation logs, it cannot determine whether a similar fix has already been attempted elsewhere, whether it improved or degraded performance, or which previous modifications led to the current behavior. As a result, different branches may repeatedly rediscover the same ineffective changes. In HGM’s shopping search, 41.8% of edits repeat an edit pattern already present in the tree (Figure 1 , left), with each repeated attempt consuming another full planning evaluation. What is needed is not simply access to more previous agents, but explicit edit–outcome context : a concise record of what was changed, what behavior changed as a result, and which changes succeeded, regressed, or proved ineffective.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，有效的改进需要搜索历史的结构化上下文。 规划基准测试暴露出的约束失败类型相对较少且反复出现，因此搜索树中的不同智能体经常遇到相似的问题。 如果编辑智能体只观察其当前父节点的评估日志，它无法判断类似的修复是否已在其他地方尝试过、该修复是提升还是降低了性能，以及之前哪些修改导致了当前的行为。 结果是，不同的分支可能反复重新发现同样无效的修改。 在 HGM 的购物搜索中，41.8% 的编辑重复了树中已有的编辑模式（图 1，左），每次重复尝试都会消耗一次完整的规划评估。 我们需要的不仅仅是访问更多之前的智能体，而是显式的「编辑—结果」上下文：一份简洁的记录，说明更改了什么、由此导致什么行为变化，以及哪些修改取得了成功、造成了回退，或被证明无效。

paragraphs.en: Second, improvement must be targeted at the specific constraints the agent violates . Planning success depends on the correctness of many interdependent decisions: a single infeasible transfer, invalid coupon, or unmet product requirement can invalidate an otherwise valid itinerary or cart. Consequently, a broad modification that improves behavior in general may still leave the failing case unresolved unless it corrects the particular constraint violation responsible for failure. Without explicit guidance, open-ended editing may instead modify an unrelated harness component or make a diffuse change that does not address the observed error. In HGM’s shopping search, 19.4% of edits target a constraint category that the parent never failed (Figure 1 , middle), and in 64.2% of edits the child retains its parent’s dominant failure category (Figure 1 , right). These results suggest that efficient self-improvement for planning requires both learning from prior edit outcomes and directing new edits toward the specific constraint failures observed in the current agent.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，改进必须针对智能体所违反的具体约束。 规划的成功取决于许多相互关联的决策的正确性：一个不可行的换乘、一张无效的优惠券或一个未满足的商品需求，都可能使原本有效的行程或购物车失效。 因此，一种在总体上改善行为的宽泛修改，除非纠正了导致失败的特定约束违反，否则可能仍无法解决失败案例。 在缺乏明确指引的情况下，开放式编辑可能转而修改无关的执行框架组件，或做出无法解决所观察错误的弥散性改动。 在 HGM 的购物搜索中，19.4% 的编辑所针对的约束类别是父智能体从未失败过的（图 1，中），并且在 64.2% 的编辑中，子智能体保留了其父智能体的主要失败类别（图 1，右）。 这些结果表明，面向规划的高效自我改进既需要从先前的编辑结果中学习，也需要将新的编辑引向当前智能体中观察到的具体约束失败。

paragraphs.en: We introduce the Huxley–Gödel Machine Dual (HGM-Dual), a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient agent harness evolution. First, it represents agentic evolution as structured contextual information. This agent-evolution context records what was changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which attempted modifications were ineffective. The editor therefore receives explicit edit–outcome attribution instead of treating previous agent snapshots as an unstructured archive. This context discourages repeated failures and allows subsequent edits to build systematically on evidence collected throughout the search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Huxley–Gödel Machine 对偶（HGM-Dual），一个面向预算高效的智能体框架演进的诊断引导式框架。 首先，它将智能体演进表示为结构化的上下文信息。 这一智能体演进上下文记录了哪些内容被更改、哪些行为得到改进或退化、以及哪些尝试性的修改是无效的。 因此，编辑器能够获得显式的编辑—结果归因，而不是把先前的智能体快照当作非结构化的存档。 这一上下文避免了重复失败，并使后续编辑能够系统地建立在搜索全过程中收集的证据之上。

paragraphs.en: Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation . For each selected parent, the framework generates complementary children: a general child , which preserves the broad and open-ended exploration of existing evolutionary methods, and specialized children , which target the harness component most likely responsible for the parent’s observed errors. The general path retains the ability to discover unexpected improvements, while the specialized path provides diagnostic-guided local refinement. Together, the dual paths balance exploration with targeted exploitation and direct the evaluation budget toward more informative regions of the harness search space.

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, two challenges remain. First, prior edit experience is either local or excessive: DGM Zhang et al. (2026b) and HGM Wang et al. (2026) primarily generate modifications from the selected parent’s code and evaluation logs, without providing enough context on the effectiveness of all edits attempted. (2026) may flood the evolution context with numerous previous candidates and raw execution traces. (2026c) , edit generation itself remains largely open-ended and may not target the harness component responsible for observed failures. Such weakly targeted exploration can require substantial evaluation resources. HGM-Dual addresses these limitations by maintaining a concise, structured agent-evolution context and by generating both a general child for broad exploration and an error-conditioned specialized child for targeted refinement.

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. We evaluate HGM-Dual on the DeepPlanning benchmark Zhang et al. (2026d) , which consists of two constrained long-horizon planning tasks: travel planning and shopping. Both require maintaining global consistency across many interdependent decisions while satisfying numerous explicit and implicit constraints. In travel planning, the agent uses nine APIs to construct minute-level itineraries of up to seven days, evaluated by 21 feasibility checks across eight dimensions such as temporal, spatial, and budget consistency. In shopping, the agent searches an average of 171 records through 15 APIs over 45 product and user attributes, while jointly selecting products and coupons subject to product, eligibility, threshold, stacking, delivery, and budget constraints. These interacting constraints make locally valid decisions insufficient: the agent must ensure that the complete itinerary or cart remains globally feasible.

paragraphs.en: Experimental Setup. The optimization process starts from an initial harness of the task agent (seed agent) with a simple multi-turn loop, a minimal task prompt, and access to the task-specific tools of the benchmark. The agent editor is an LLM agent that updates the harness components (e.g., prompt, workflow, tool, verifier) of the task agent. The objective is to obtain the best-performing task agent by optimizing the harness alone; the underlying model weights are never updated. Information (e.g., code, logs, failing traces) supplied to the editor is gathered deterministically by a fixed procedure rather than through agentic exploration. For both travel planning and shopping tasks, we optimize on 60 60 samples and evaluate on 120 120 samples ( 60 60 unseen samples), so that generalization beyond the optimization set is measured explicitly. paragraphs.en: Performance Comparison to Baseline Approaches. Table 1 reports the performance comparison to baselines (HGM, HGM-CA, HGM-CF) at 4000 4000 evaluation budget. Vanilla HGM barely moves beyond the seed harness on either domain, gaining only 0.60 0.60 composite points on travel and 1.21 1.21 on shopping, and leaving shopping case accuracy unchanged at 50.83 50.83 . This confirms that an editor designed for coding benchmarks transfers poorly to long-horizon planning, and motivates the customized variants. HGM-CF the strongest baseline on all four metrics ( 84.11 84.11 and 86.67 86.67 composite, 56.25 56.25 and 60.83 60.83 case accuracy). HGM-Dual attains the best result on every metric in both domains, improving over HGM-CF by 3.66 3.66 and 2.56 2.56 composite points and by 8.13 8.13 and 5.84 5.84 case accuracy points on travel and shopping, respectively. Notably, the margin is consistently larger in case accuracy than in composite score, indicating that HGM-Dual does not merely accumulate partial credit across checkpoints but converts a larger fraction of plans into fully constraint-satisfying solutions

paragraphs.en: Budget Efficiency. We have analyzed the budget efficiency of HGM-Dual by evaluating the performance of selected best agents at different evaluation budget steps. We have considered selecting best agents at 1k, 2k, 3k and 4k evaluations and evaluate it on all 120 120 instances for both travel and shopping task (Fig. 4 (a,b)). On travel (Fig. 4 (a)), HGM-CF is slightly ahead at 1k ( 84.9 84.9 vs. 83.8 83.8 ) but then stalls. HGM-CF returns the same agent at 1k, 2k and 3k and ends at 84.1 84.1 . HGM-Dual, in contrast, improves at every checkpoint, overtakes HGM-CF at 2k ( 85.7 85.7 ) and reaches 87.8 87.8 at 4k. On shopping (Fig. 4 (b)), HGM-Dual makes most of its gain within the first 1k evaluations, rising from 81.9 81.9 to 90.4 90.4 , and stays near that level through 4k ( 89.2 89.2 ), whereas HGM-CF improves gradually and ends at 86.7 86.7 . The domain-customized variant HGM-CA remains below both methods across the budget range on travel and below HGM-Dual throughout on shopping. Overall, HGM-Dual converts the evaluation budget into performance far more efficiently than HGM-CF: it either keeps improving where HGM-CF plateaus (travel) or reaches HGM-CF’s final score using roughly a quarter of the budget (shopping). Note that HGM-Dual’s rejected child’s evaluation is also counted towards the total evaluation budget used.
paragraphs.zh: 预算效率。 我们通过评估在不同评估预算步数下所选最优智能体的表现，分析了 HGM-Dual 的预算效率。 我们考虑在 1k、2k、3k 和 4k 次评估时选择最优智能体，并在旅行和购物任务的全部 120 120 个实例上进行评估（图 4 (a,b)）。 在旅行任务上（图 4 (a)），HGM-CF 在 1k 时略微领先（ 84.9 84.9 对 83.8 83.8 ），但随后停滞不前。 HGM-CF 在 1k、2k 和 3k 时返回同一个智能体，最终停留在 84.1 84.1 。 相比之下，HGM-Dual 在每个检查点都有提升，在 2k 时超越 HGM-CF（ 85.7 85.7 ），并在 4k 时达到 87.8 87.8 。 在购物任务上（图 4 (b)），HGM-Dual 在前 1k 次评估中获得了大部分收益，从 81.9 81.9 上升到 90.4 90.4 ，并在此后直到 4k 时都保持在该水平附近（ 89.2 89.2 ），而 HGM-CF 则逐步提升，最终达到 86.7 86.7 。 在整个预算范围内，领域定制变体 HGM-CA 在旅行任务上始终低于两种方法，在购物任务上则始终低于 HGM-Dual。 总体而言，HGM-Dual 将评估预算转化为性能的效率远高于 HGM-CF：在 HGM-CF 停滞不前的地方（旅行任务），它能持续提升；或者用大约四分之一的预算（购物任务）就达到 HGM-CF 的最终分数。 请注意，HGM-Dual 被拒绝的子智能体的评估也计入所用总评估预算。

To identify the source of these gains, we decompose the failures of HGM-Dual and HGM-CF’s final agent ( 4 4 k budget) on the 60 60 held-out task instances (Fig. 4 (c,d)). Each row is an evaluator-defined error category, and each marker gives a method’s change in the fraction of tasks failing that category relative to the seed agent; negative values indicate fewer errors. The advantage of HGM-Dual therefore stems more from resolving frequently appearing failure modes that HGM-CF leaves untouched.

paragraphs.en: Performance Comparison at Low Budget Regime. Due to the high cost of long-horizon agent evaluation and performance plateau, we evaluate ADAS and GEPA only at 1000 1000 evaluations. Table 2 reports the low-budget regime performance for different baselines. paragraphs.en: We analyze and compare the edits made by two variants of HGM runs: HGM-CF and HGM-CF + Agent Evolution Context (no error-conditioned child generation). For each edit/expansion, we record its outcome against its parent on the cases both were evaluated on, its source diff, and the redundancy of its stated goal, measured as the maximum TF-IDF cosine against the goals of its ancestors. Table 3 shows that the Agent Evolution Context makes edits less redundant within a lineage ( 0.22 → 0.17 0.22\rightarrow 0.17 ). Edits are less destructive: they worsen fewer instances ( 37.6 % → 31.9 % 37.6\%\rightarrow 31.9\% ). Most importantly, adding Agent Evolution Context in the editor improves child agent’s performance compared to their parent more often ( 31.3 % → 41.0 % 31.3\%\rightarrow 41.0\% ). Therefore, the Agent Evolution Context alters the proposal distribution of the self-improvement steps positively rather than only improving the final score.

paragraphs.en: We introduced HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for efficient agent harness optimization. By incorporating structured agent-evolution context, HGM-Dual enables the editor to learn from prior edit outcomes and avoid redundant or ineffective modifications. Its error-conditioned dual-path generation further combines open-ended exploration with targeted refinement of error-relevant harness components. Experiments on travel and shopping planning tasks demonstrate that these complementary mechanisms outperform strong self-improving baselines while substantially reducing the required evaluation budget. Our ablations further show that evolution context provides consistent performance gains, whereas dual-path generation accelerates improvement under constrained budgets. Together, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling evolutionary history and balancing general with error-targeted search can make agent harness evolution more effective and resource-efficient. Future work may extend the evolution context beyond individual lineages to share useful edit-outcome evidence across the entire search tree. Future work could jointly learn an evolving context and dual-path manager to adapt evidence selection, editing strategies, and resource allocation throughout the search. Finally, evaluating HGM-Dual across broader task domains and online environments would help characterize the transferability and long-term robustness of the evolved harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HGM-Dual，一个用于高效智能体框架优化的诊断引导式框架。 通过引入结构化的智能体演化上下文，HGM-Dual 使编辑器能够从先前的编辑结果中学习，避免冗余或无效的修改。 其基于错误条件的双路径生成进一步将开放式探索与对错误相关框架组件的针对性改进相结合。 在旅行和购物规划任务上的实验表明，这些互补机制优于强大的自我改进基线，同时大幅降低了所需的评估预算。 我们的消融实验进一步表明，演化上下文带来了一致的性能提升，而双路径生成则在受限预算下加速了改进。 总而言之，这些结果表明，显式建模演化历史并平衡通用搜索与错误导向搜索，可以使智能体框架演化更有效且更节省资源。 未来的工作可以将演化上下文扩展到单个谱系之外，以便在整个搜索树中共享有用的编辑结果证据。 未来的工作还可以联合学习不断演化的上下文和双路径管理器，以在整个搜索过程中自适应地选择证据、编辑策略和资源分配。 最后，在更广泛的任务领域和在线环境中评估 HGM-Dual，将有助于刻画演化出的框架的迁移能力和长期鲁棒性。

sents.en: We introduced HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for efficient agent harness optimization.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 HGM-Dual，一个用于高效智能体框架优化的诊断引导式框架。

sents.en: By incorporating structured agent-evolution context, HGM-Dual enables the editor to learn from prior edit outcomes and avoid redundant or ineffective modifications.
sents.zh: 通过引入结构化的智能体演化上下文，HGM-Dual 使编辑器能够从先前的编辑结果中学习，避免冗余或无效的修改。

sents.en: Its error-conditioned dual-path generation further combines open-ended exploration with targeted refinement of error-relevant harness components.
sents.zh: 其基于错误条件的双路径生成进一步将开放式探索与对错误相关框架组件的针对性改进相结合。

sents.en: Experiments on travel and shopping planning tasks demonstrate that these complementary mechanisms outperform strong self-improving baselines while substantially reducing the required evaluation budget.
sents.zh: 在旅行和购物规划任务上的实验表明，这些互补机制优于强大的自我改进基线，同时大幅降低了所需的评估预算。

sents.en: Our ablations further show that evolution context provides consistent performance gains, whereas dual-path generation accelerates improvement under constrained budgets.
sents.zh: 我们的消融实验进一步表明，演化上下文带来了一致的性能提升，而双路径生成则在受限预算下加速了改进。

sents.en: Together, these results demonstrate that explicitly modeling evolutionary history and balancing general with error-targeted search can make agent harness evolution more effective and resource-efficient.
sents.zh: 总而言之，这些结果表明，显式建模演化历史并平衡通用搜索与错误导向搜索，可以使智能体框架演化更有效且更节省资源。

sents.en: Future work may extend the evolution context beyond individual lineages to share useful edit-outcome evidence across the entire search tree.
sents.zh: 未来的工作可以将演化上下文扩展到单个谱系之外，以便在整个搜索树中共享有用的编辑结果证据。

sents.en: Future work could jointly learn an evolving context and dual-path manager to adapt evidence selection, editing strategies, and resource allocation throughout the search.
sents.zh: 未来的工作还可以联合学习不断演化的上下文和双路径管理器，以在整个搜索过程中自适应地选择证据、编辑策略和资源分配。

sents.en: Finally, evaluating HGM-Dual across broader task domains and online environments would help characterize the transferability and long-term robustness of the evolved harnesses.
sents.zh: 最后，在更广泛的任务领域和在线环境中评估 HGM-Dual，将有助于刻画演化出的框架的迁移能力和长期鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 2 summarizes the complete procedure. HGM-Dual keeps the search loop of HGM ( Wang et al., 2026 ) : at each iteration, it either expands the archive by modifying a selected parent or evaluates an existing harness on one additional task. Both choices are made by Thompson sampling, and at the end of the search the harness with the highest posterior success rate is returned. The only change is in the expansion step. Instead of producing a single open-ended modification, HGM-Dual calls Expand (Algorithm 1 ), which builds the evolution context from the parent’s lineage (Section 3.3 ), generates one general and two error-conditioned children (Section 3.4 ), and adds only the strongest child to the archive.

sents.en: For each harness ℋ \mathcal{H} , n success ​ ( ℋ ) n_{\mathrm{success}}(\mathcal{H}) and n failure ​ ( ℋ ) n_{\mathrm{failure}}(\mathcal{H}) count its passed and failed evaluation tasks, while n success C ​ ( ℋ ) n^{C}_{\mathrm{success}}(\mathcal{H}) and n failure C ​ ( ℋ ) n^{C}_{\mathrm{failure}}(\mathcal{H}) aggregate these counts over its clade, i.e., the subtree rooted at ℋ \mathcal{H} .
sents.zh: 对于每个测试框架 ℋ \mathcal{H} ，n success ​ ( ℋ ) n_{\mathrm{success}}(\mathcal{H}) 和 n failure ​ ( ℋ ) n_{\mathrm{failure}}(\mathcal{H}) 统计其通过和失败的评估任务数，而 n success C ​ ( ℋ ) n^{C}_{\mathrm{success}}(\mathcal{H}) 和 n failure C ​ ( ℋ ) n^{C}_{\mathrm{failure}}(\mathcal{H}) 则在其进化枝（即以 ℋ \mathcal{H} 为根的子树）上汇总这些计数。

sents.en: The clade counts measure how productive the descendants of ℋ \mathcal{H} have been and guide parent selection.
sents.zh: 进化枝计数衡量 ℋ \mathcal{H} 的后代有多高的产出，并用于指导父节点选择。

sents.en: The individual counts measure the harness’s own performance and guide evaluation and final selection.
sents.zh: 个体计数衡量该测试框架自身的表现，并用于指导评估和最终选择。

sents.en: N t N_{t} is the number of evaluations spent so far.
sents.zh: N t N_{t} 是迄今为止已花费的评估次数。

sents.en: The archive is expanded when | 𝒜 | ≤ N t α |\mathcal{A}|\leq N_{t}^{\alpha} , where α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] controls how quickly the tree widens relative to the evaluation budget. τ \tau is a scheduler that increases over the search.
sents.zh: 当 | 𝒜 | ≤ N t α |\mathcal{A}|\leq N_{t}^{\alpha} 时，存档会被扩展，其中 α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] 控制树相对于评估预算的扩展速度。 τ \tau 是一个随搜索过程递增的调度器。

sents.en: It sharpens the sampled Beta distributions over time, shifting the search from exploration toward exploitation.
sents.zh: 它随时间使采样得到的 Beta 分布变得更尖锐，将搜索从探索转向利用。

sents.en: S C ​ ( ℋ ) S^{C}(\mathcal{H}) and S ⁡ ( ℋ ) S(\mathcal{H}) are the Thompson samples drawn from the clade-level and individual Beta posteriors, used to select the parent to expand and the harness to evaluate, respectively.
sents.zh: S C ​ ( ℋ ) S^{C}(\mathcal{H}) 和 S ⁡ ( ℋ ) S(\mathcal{H}) 分别是从进化枝级和个体 Beta 后验中抽取的 Thompson 样本，分别用于选择要扩展的父节点和要评估的测试框架。

sents.en: Finally, I ρ I_{\rho} is the ρ \rho -percentile of a harness’s Beta posterior.
sents.zh: 最后，I ρ I_{\rho} 是测试框架 Beta 后验的 ρ \rho 百分位数。

sents.en: Returning the harness that maximizes it favors candidates whose high success rate is supported by sufficient evaluations.
sents.zh: 返回使其最大化的测试框架，会偏好那些高成功率有足够评估次数支持的候选者。
